about: Layouts of macOS's Preboot list of Recovery administrators, <group>/var/db/AdminUserRecoveryInfo.plist, and what the source-owner proof decides for each. Modes are octal; 'symlink' replaces the item with a symbolic link to a copy; 'missing' removes it; a file 'other-owner' is a hard link to a file of another owner. extraLink names the folder that gets a second hard link to the file. content: xml, binary, empty, garbage, array, oversize. Measured layouts name their source; the others are synthetic. All values are synthetic test data; no account or volume identifier from any Mac is recorded.

layouts.name: macos-26-measured
layouts.source: Measured read-only on macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), 2026-11-08: group 0777 root, var 0755, var/db 0755, file 0644, 1 link, XML

layouts.name: macos-27.2-measured
layouts.source: Measured read-only with stat on two Macs, reported independently: macOS 27.2 (26B123) on a MacBook Air M4 after diskutil apfs updatePreboot, and a second macOS 27.x Mac with the same layout: group 0755 root, var 0777 root, var/db 0777 root, no sticky bits, file 0644 root
